verdict.rationale: USPTO does run its own machine API: api.uspto.gov answers unauthenticated requests with a structured auth challenge, a developer portal exists, and Patent Center documents direct API calls against Workbench/view-application surfaces. However, the evidence only shows API access for viewing applications. The core UI actions (filing trademark and patent applications, paying fees, recording assignments, responding to office actions) are documented only as web-UI flows, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: evidence of API-based filing, API-based fee payment, API-based assignments and responses, and a published API spec or parity statement.
